name: seongho-ops
description: Applies code conventions; guides development and Argo CD operations; routes operational CLIs; reuses 1Password CLI sessions; opens protected previews; and packages Seongho's port cleanup utility. Composes Korean writing in the user’s voice with selective polishing.

interface.shortDescription: Guide development work and Argo CD operations; route operational CLIs; open previews; and provide k.
interface.longDescription: Seongho Ops provides lightweight, implicitly invocable brainstorming, systematic debugging, completion verification, test-driven development, performance engineering, Argo CD operations, and 1Password skills. It separates Kubernetes, Argo CD project, and Argo CD Application RBAC; selects the correct authenticated local CLI; reuses task terminal sessions for 1Password access to reduce repeated biometric prompts; securely opens protected Vercel previews in the Codex browser; and bundles the k command for force-stopping processes that own explicitly requested local ports. Its code-convention skill applies TypeScript/React naming, type safety, declarative code and refactoring guidance, preferring the project design system or a shared shadcn/ui layer when none exists. Its write-korean skill combines optional write-like-me style references and bundled MIT-licensed Korean polishing rules while preserving meaning and the requested output format.
